name: Second Alamein: 23 October–4 November 1942 (linked research)

aim.cw: Open a breach west of El Alamein while holding the Egyptian base, then exploit it without losing the mobile force.
aim.axis: Keep the Alamein defence coherent, deny a Commonwealth break-through and preserve an escape route if the line fails.

about: Linked daily trial for the historical offensive beginning on the night of 23 October and the Axis withdrawal from 3 November. The marked breach is one passable map hex west of El Alamein, not a measured minefield gap. No breakthrough, surrender, retreat or fixed tank balance is imposed. The map lacks the researched mine belt and the rules lack the full bombardment and engineer plan; the trial result cannot be treated as a historical battle reconstruction.
